p: feast which was in the seventh: When the things were dedicated and brought into the temple.

month: Called in Hebrew Ethanim, containing part of September and part of October, 1Ki 8:2, which moves the Jews called the first month, because they say that the world was created in that month, and after they came from Egypt, they began at March: but because this opinion is uncertain, we always make March the first as the best writers do.
the two tables which Moses put: For Aaron's rod and manna were taken from there before it was brought to this place.
sanctified: Were prepared to serve the Lord.
as one: They all played the same tune.
For he is good: This was the effect of their songs, Ps 118:1,136:1.
